subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried won his appeal and his fraud conviction was overturned in 2026.

summary: Sam Bankman‑Fried was convicted of fraud in November 2023 and sentenced to 25 years in March 2024. As of mid‑2024 his appeal was still pending, and there are no credible reports of his conviction being overturned in 2025 or 2026.
